plan.description: A pixelized SpyHunter-inspired single-level racing/combat game built on top of the Next.js 16 Canvas2D scaffold. The player controls a spy car that emerges from a truck in an intro sequence, navigates a vertically-scrolling road, collects weapons and ammo from road gadgets, destroys enemy traffic, and defeats a final armored boss to win. All rendering uses a pixel-art aesthetic via a shared pixel utility layer.
plan.intent: Create the spyhunter game, with a pixelized UI, where the car starts coming from a truck everytime (like the real game), and then the car starts in the road, with a speed limit, i can slighlty move up (to a limit) (accelerate, to specific position > midle of the screen) and to get back to the bottom of the road... random cars pass by, and ocassionally there are gadgets/suprises in the road (eg weapons and amo), create a boss that i have to kill. Only 1 level, boss dies > i win.
